envVars.name: SIMMER_API_KEY
envVars.description: Simmer SDK key. Only needed for --simmer-market, to turn a Simmer market id into a Polymarket condition id. The check itself needs no key.

envVars.name: PREDGE_API_BASE
envVars.description: Override the Predge API base URL (default https://api.predge.io).
